iti82:2.1: bhikkhave devesu devasaddā niccharanti samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:2.3: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya ceteti, tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati:
iti82:2.4: Eso ariyasāvako mārena saddhiṃ saṅgāmāya cetetīti.
iti82:2.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogam-anuyutto viharati, tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati:
iti82:3.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe-va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati:
iti82:4.2: Eso ariyasāvako vijitasaṅgāmo, tam-eva saṅgāmasīsaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasatīti.
iti82:4.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:4.4: Ime kho bhikkhave tayo devesu devasaddā niccharanti samayā samayaṃ upādāyā-ti.
